facts.fact: The ICS says SEYID, introduced in 2022, lets users create a Digital Identity for accessing government services online.
The ICS says that from 17 September 2024 permit holders register for a virtual ID card on the SEYID website or app instead of receiving a physical card.

SYC.note: No civil register link is mentioned.
No count or share is given.
No number at birth is mentioned.

facts.fact: The ICS says it continues to issue the National Identity Number and, from 17 September 2024, no longer issues physical ID cards to permit holders, who use the SEYID virtual ID.

SYC.note: No public register keyed on the ID number is mentioned.

facts.fact: The ICS says it issues the National Identity Number, and permit holders from 17 September 2024 receive a SEYID virtual ID, which has existed since 2022.
